thread.title: Apple crosses threshold needed for $1 trillion market cap

author: From marketwatch.com
title: Apple crosses threshold needed for $1 trillion market cap
text: From marketwatch.com Apple Inc. shares briefly hit the price level needed to become the first U.S. company to reach a $1 trillion market capitalization Thursday. Apple AAPL, +2.51% shares reached a price of $207.05 in intraday trading Thursday, the price needed for Apple to officially hit the trillion-dollar mark, based on its most up-to-date share count of 4.83 billion as of July 20. The current market-cap calculations assume that Apples share count hasnt budged since mid-July, though thats unlikely given the companys rapid pace of share buybacks.
